154000.description:
Detective Yajima is your typical well-seasoned, rough detective who has dedicated himself to his work: solving tough cases. Ryo, who was abandoned at the age of five and grew up on the streets, also dedicates himself to his method of survival: pickpocketing. Although they got off to a rough start, the pair of two opposites have finally found Peace in Paradise. Nothing can seem to break their bond now. Ryo accepts Detective Yajima even with all of his rough edges, and Detective Yajima accepts Ryo regardless of his past. But what will they do when that very past starts creeping up on them? What kind of incidents will they find themselves in next?

(Source: Futekiya, translated)

She had just transmigrated and hadn't even gotten used to her new identity yet, before she was immediately forced into an arranged marriage. What? I have to marry that blind cripple the Third Prince, and get ambushed along the way?! She is a strong, independent woman. See how she overcame the concubine, brought the servants to heel, and flirted with her handsome new husband. Living in the past won't stop her from making waves!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

154003.description:
In the entertainment industry, there’s a certain profession called “professional fans”. Professional fans earn their living through chasing stars. When a novelist Zhu Xiaotong who lost her direction in life met a singer Li Xixing who managed to fulfill her dreams, Zhu Xiaotong decided to become a “professional fan” for Li Xixing and her shield. This time, Zhu Xiaotong will use her own ways to lead everyone onto the correct path of chasing a star, creating this chaotic Li Xixing support squad!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

154007.description:
When a famous author asks magazine reporter Isobel to interview her, Isobel heads to Brazil. The moment Isobel meets the author’s son-in-law, she freezes. It is Alejandro, the man she met in London three years ago, the man who disappeared suddenly after spending a night of passion with her. How could he marry another woman while she pined for him? And how did he get the unsightly scar on his face? Isobel is disturbed. It soon becomes clear that this reunion is no coincidence, and Isobel shudders with fear when she realizes his goal!

(Source: Harlequin / SB Creative)

154008.description:
Natori Midori has been giving it all at her hum-drum office job for three years now, only to have the rug pulled out from under her when she’s suddenly laid off. But just as she’s feeling lost and adrift, she is summoned to the world of the visual novel she’s currently playing, Fairy Tale of Jewels. And the person who summoned her there? None other than the game’s cruel villainess, Lapis Tenebrau, who’s trying to take down the main cast of the game. Driven into a corner, Natori pretends she’s psychic and uses her knowledge of the game to save Lapis from danger. Now Lapis has taken a shine to her, and is going to make Natori her private secretary?! Can Natori handle this new job, and her growing feelings for her villainess boss?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Isn't it exciting to imagine doing it with an innocent teacher? I wanted to confess my feelings to the perfect teacher who has it all once I graduate. But she just said that she is quitting her job to get married...!

154010.description:
A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

Meet Mimi, a college grad working part-time at a convenience store. Once an aspiring idol, she abandoned her dream when her group failed to make it big. Enter Ibuki, a rising star inspired by Mimi’s past. Their unexpected encounters reignite Mimi’s passion for the spotlight. Together, they decide to audition for a high-stakes idol competition show. Can they achieve their dreams and forge an unbreakable bond, or will the intense rivalry tear them apart?

154043.description:
There’s only one thing that’s keeping Han Sekye alive: the blond man in his dreams. No matter how bad it gets, how lonely he is, he can count on the man to come meet him in his dreams and make it all okay. So what is he to do when the man suddenly stops coming? Sekye falls apart and for years, he struggles with depression living on in a world without the man. Then one day, Woo Yijun appears in front of him, looking just like the man in his dreams. And seeing that he is an aspiring actor, Sekye hires Yijun to act out for him the man from his dreams. Sekye knows that it isn’t the same, that this can’t go on, but he so needs the world that used to be his…

(Source: Lezhin US)

154044.description:
Nobleman Park Hyowon is no stranger to the pleasures of the flesh. If anything, he’s actually quite experienced. So when a friend mentions an oh-so-secret sex toy workshop, Hyowon’s interest is thoroughly piqued. But the coarse Shinwoo is nothing like the refined artisan Hyowon expected, and he finds himself drawn in by the man’s almost rude nature. So much so, that he’s determined to get past that rough exterior, and what better way than by targeting his pride? Accusing Shinwoo of lacking confidence in his products, Hyowon demands a hands-on demonstration, and soon gets much more than he bargained for when Shinwoo shows him pleasure he could never have imagined. There’s just one thing Hyowon can’t figure out. Just how much of his pleasure is caused by the art…and how much by the artisan?

(Source: Lezhin US)

154045.description:
“I know you want me to eat you up.”

When Honoka sees men eating, she can’t help fantasizing about them. She secretly posts her thoughts on social media. One day, she suddenly gets transferred to another division. Her new boss, Akito Nakamura turns out to be a handsome devil whose manner of eating is very much to Honoka’s liking!

“I can make your wish come true.” Did he see right through her!? His thick fingers and tongue keep reaching for her sensitive spots until her body is just about ready to be eaten...!"

Selina is a celebrated movie director while Phoebe is the richest woman in Hong'ao City. Selina developed feelings for Phoebe, while Phoebe took an interest in her as soon as she saw her. But with Phoebe's friends and family opposing her relationship with Selina, will their bond last?

(Source: INKR)

154047.description:
A man dies a mysterious death just outside Shinjuku Station. Eight years later, his son, Yodomi Arakawa, is leading a tranquil life until he meets…an invisible man?! And to learn the truth behind his father's death, Yodomi will have to become invisible himself...

Young mafia boss Hajime thought he was shot and killed by his enemies... Until he snapped into the world of the Warring States period! When the one and only great Nobunaga Oda takes a liking to him, Nobunaga renames him Ranmaru Mori for some reason, but that isn't Hajime's biggest shock. Nobunaga fondles him all over, kisses his neck, and forces himself into Hajime's untouched parts. Frustrated as he is with his domination, Hajime can't stop moaning. Turned into a Nobunaga's subordinate, what will become of Hajime?

(Source: Renta!)

154056.description:
In the northern lands where war continues without end, young Almark hopes to be a mercenary like his father one day. Thinking the timid boy ill-suited for such a life, however, his worried father envisions a different future for him—all the way at the Nork Magical Academy in the peaceful South, once he's old enough to attend. And so, despite Almark's efforts on and off the battlefield, he eventually sets out for the academy to respect his father's wishes. But what lies ahead on his journey to becoming a magician?

(Source: Yen Press)

154057.description:
In the near future of a world whose history diverges from our own, the Soviet Union remains intact and the Cold War has continued for two centuries. Cyborg thieves and rogues roam the streets, and the powers that be conspire in secret… In the far north city of Moscow, the people’s will, prosperous futures, and rights to freedom and truth have long been lost to war. But there lives a certain man with antique machine guns always in tow, beholden to no organization, whom they call a “Janitor”…

(Source: Yen Press)

154058.description:
I was in bed with a cold, when a beautiful girl with cat ears appeared by my side. She claimed that she was my pet cat, transformed…!? The cat usually acts cool, but the cat-girl is all dere-dere. A love story with a mysterious beauty—. The popular YouTube video-manga with over 2.5 million views serialized on the Web!

(Source: Comic Newtype, translated)

title.romaji: Chiteki de Cool na Kouhai Bijo, Ore no Kai Neko ni Naru.

154059.description:
The year is 2160, and the Cold War between the United States and the Soviet Union has not yet ended. Cyborg soldiers returning from war roam about, their cybernetic enhancements monitored by the authorities. Behind the scenes, government-affiliated organizations, Western spies, and mafiosos hunt each other down. This is Moscow, a city where freedom, truth, and prosperity have long since disappeared. Danila Kragin, a disposable asset called a "janitor," is a flesh-and-blood mercenary. He now sprints down alleyways, submachine gun in hand. He must make it home—not only for his beloved Stasia, but for his younger siblings waiting for his return.

(Source: Yen Press)

154060.description:
Yuuki wakes up to find herself wearing a maid's uniform in a strange manor. After wandering into the dining room, she comes across five other girls, each in the exact same outfit. Soon, the girls learn that the manor is brimming with lethal weapons and an array of deadly traps…and that they can only escape by playing the most gruesome of games. As the terrifying truth sets in, each girl's face goes pale—except Yuuki's. Why? Because this isn't her first go-round. That's right—Yuuki is a professional death game player who lives off the prize money she collects from winning brutal killing competitions, and she's not about to let this chance pass her by.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
title.romaji: Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.

154061.description:
When the tier-seven assassin Ye Banxia was reborn into the 21st century, she was determined to live this life to the fullest. But her dreams of a happy and peaceful life were shattered on her very first day of college. What? That incredibly handsome boy was actually the reincarnation of the chief detective who tormented her in her past life? Well, I swear that in this life I won't be your plaything anymore!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

154062.description:
Bubbly Ying Yin joins her dream university and unexpectedly meets her former first love, the now grumpy and aloof Yuchuan Ji. A comical mishap sparks a sham romance, bringing mayhem to his structured world and reawakening his heart. Amidst their laugh-out-loud misadventures and hidden secrets, will their pretend love transform into a genuine tale of passion and dreams? Get ready for a rollercoaster of sweetness, chaos, and romance in this captivating journey of rediscovery and affection.

(Source: Tapas)

154063.description:
Our 38-year old protagonist seemed to have a happy family and a perfect life with her 41-year old husband and seven-year old daughter.
But it all fell apart when she aborted a second child in secret.

154065.description:
Under the bright lights of showbiz, all sorts of rumors and drama spill onto the scene every day. Behind the battle for public opinion, slick players know how to manipulate people and turn the situation to their favor. They are the "crisis PR" agents! Zuo Bing is one of the best PR agents out there. No matter the situation, she can always catch the lying "wolf" and turn things around. But despite all her experience, for this one PR battle, she will meet an opponent who will knock the queen off her throne…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

154066.description:
No cultivation, no jobs, no apprentices, and no money. Those were the Four No's Chu Bai inherited from the master of the Siwu Sect. His only companion was Xiao Guo, an eight-month-old girl who's supposed to become his fiancee in an arranged marriage. In order to restore his sect (and make some money), he will set out an a hilarious demon-hunting adventure!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

154067.description:
Revenge and love of the last remaining werewolves!

Luna, the youngest prince of the Airoon Kingdom, is kidnapped by mysterious gangsters while on his way to an allied Qatar country against a strategic marriage. Luna, dragged by the kidnappers' chief, promises to do whatever it takes to save the life of the injured maid on his behalf, begging the boss for her life...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Compilation of the SpoHame series.

154070.description:
S-class Esper Eunhyeon is forced into a rural transfer and paired with a male Guide, Jaewoo. Bored and biding time until he can return, he's shocked to find Jaewoo tangled up with another Esper. Could there be more to this “dull” partner than meets the eye?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes a prologue.

154071.description:
The culprit is known. However, testimony by psychics cannot be considered as evidence. What should they do?!

The spiritual medium Hisui Jogashira uses her psychic abilities to identify the culprit, while mystery writer Shirou Kagetsuki presents additional logical "evidence other than the words of a psychic." The two of them have tackled many difficult cases, but the sinister hand of a perpetrator behind a shocking series of murders is closing in on Hisui!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: medium 霊媒探偵城塚翡翠

154072.description:
In the spring of her second year of high school, Fuyuka Yukinoshita starts working part-time at a maid cafe. She dreams of becoming someone who can make people smile, like the manager she admired, but she is always getting flustered by her idiosyncratic co-workers!

It is the magic that makes you smile. A fluffy and sweet moment.

(Source: Comic Cune, translated)
154072.hashtag: #夢見るメイドのティータイム

title.native: 夢見るメイドのティータイム

154073.description:
Ever since starting university, Cen Lin hasn't had a single night's sleep without being awoken by terrifying nightmares. One night, after receiving a strange charm from his landlord, he's rescued in his dream by a mysterious beast. Desperate to reclaim his sleepless nights, Cen begins researching the creatures and protectors that plague and protect him while he rests.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 special chapters.

154074.description:
When Zhang Li left for a trip to the Ebiz ruins, he didn’t expect to bring back company, especially not a man made of stone! Though Li grows fond of the living statue, their time together doesn’t last long, as “Rocky” soon crumbles before Li’s eyes. Wishing for a miracle, Li suddenly finds himself in Ebiz far back in the past and reunites with Rocky. However, his companion is no longer a statue but rather the nation’s king, who doesn’t recognize Li at all and imprisons him! How will Li escape this predicament and get his beloved back?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Till We Meet Again, My King

154077.description: In a remote island of the Southern Sea, where a severe curse has deeply rooted itself in all living things, the extraordinary story of exorcism involving a mysterious girl named Mi-Rae begins.
synonyms: The Antique Shop of the Future

154078.description:
What if you could return to a moment in your memories that can be recalled by a scent? This is the story of a perfumer, who goes by the name J, and the people who are tranced by the perfumes J makes in which the extract of a fragrance is reminiscent of their nostalgia.

(Source: Naver, translated)

154079.description:
Since childhood, Bak-Ha has been able to see "things" that others can't. On the first day at his new school, Bak-Ha meets Jin-Do, and due to the sickeningly sweet smell Bak-Ha has, Jin-Do notices he is different, just like himself. As they get closer, Bak-Ha finds out that he was the moonchild, the mythical creature who ruled the spirits in the past, and realizes that this is why the ghosts and demons are after him.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

154080.description:
Angel is on the run from his brother and Ian Summers when he resorts to hiding out at his childhood friend Herman Black's house. During their time living together, Herman turns out to be devoted to Angel while Angel blames Herman for the way things turned out. They may be lovers now, but their history goes way back. Will their reunion turn out to be a curse or a blessing?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: バンパイアと竜の甘美な駆け引き

154082.description: The story about two girls who share a common fascination for astrology (especially the sign of Cancer).

154083.description:
I have a father and a mother. I have an older sister and a younger brother who are not married yet. We are an ordinary family that you would find anywhere! But the family dynamics will change when the middle daughter gets divorced. A series of stories depicting the different meanings of "love" for each member of the family!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Includes two bonus one-shots.

154084.description:
The twelve animals of the Chinese Zodiac represents the twelve months. But they also represent twelve guardians, the twelve heirs of the zodiac bloodline, each with its own special powers, who have watched over the East in secret. The Kirin is the mythical beast which ruled the East. When the one with kirin's blood is born into the world, he will rule over the twelve zodiacs, and they will devote their lives to defend the East.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Exorcist Fang Hui has searched for the Cirrus Cloud Scroll for 10 years, with no success. When he comes across an all-powerful sword, he's launched through a magical portal, where he encounters the slain Wan. He resurrects her with a special spell, and though she can’t recall her origins, the one thing she recognizes is… Fang? A hothead, a mysterious girl, and more join them as this eclectic group sets out on an adventure full of demons and magic in hopes of unlocking the mysteries of their pasts and the prized scroll!

154095.description:
Though Yuri may look like any other high schooler, his life is a ceaseless onslaught of the worst luck imaginable—so when he hears about Blade Skill Online, the ultra-immersive VRMMO where luck is a stat you can control, he can’t wait to start playing and escape his IRL problems. Following the advice of an online guide, he chooses the summoner class with a bow for his weapon, and for his stats, he pours every last point into luck, naturally. Thus begins his blessed online life! Or at least, that was the plan. He soon learns he’s been trolled—summoners are useless, the bow is garbage, and the game’s barely playable with his abysmal stats! To top it off, a bald barbarian starts hitting on him barely a minute into the game because the avatar randomizer made him into a hot girl! Still, Yuri’s used to dealing with whatever life throws at him, and he’s not going to let the trolls have the last laugh! He’ll push his luck to the limit and leave the rest of BSO’s players racing to keep up!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

154096.description:
Yuri has been cursed with the worst luck imaginable for as long as he can remember. That's why things are bound to look up with the release of Blade Skill Online, a VRMMO where luck is a stat you can actually control! Eager to the right build, Yuri follows an online guide and picks the summoner class with a bow for his weapon. Now reversing fortune is just a matter of dumping all of his stat points into luck!

Or at least, that was the plan. Turns out he's been trolled! Summoners are useless, the bow is garbage, and the game's barely playable with his abysmal stats. Completely shutting out the outside world with a mask!!! One day, Suzu, a gloomy college boy with no friends and poor communication skills, loses his one-of-a-kind, precious mascot, "Kappa-chan." While looking around desperately, the one who picked it up and called out to him was the popular and handsome playboy, Sasamuro Aiji, with pretty girls in tow. Though he wanted to get it back quickly and flee the scene, Aiji deliberately teased him and wouldn't give it back, making Suzu cry.

Suzu managed to get Kappa-chan back, but on top of dealing with kind of person he most disliked, Kappa-chan was damaged, sending him into a depression. The next day, Aiji gets involved with him again by using him as an excuse to run away from his fans. With no concern for Suzu's feelings of dislike, Aiji demands his thanks for picking up Kappa-chan. But when Suzu bluntly told Aiji, "A cheery person like you is a land mine!" Aiji suddenly kissed him through his maskー!!!?

The handsome, popular, and outgoing guy x Timid, gloomy boy with no friends and poor communication skills. The love between two polar opposites tied together by the cute and mysterious "Kappa-chan."

One day, after two months of working cleaning bathrooms at a hotel, Johan's predecessor asks him to leave because he's coming back. All Johan has left is his younger brother, Philip.

A man says to Johan that he resembles someone he knew well, and suddenly offers him a job. Maybe it's a scam or something dangerous, but it pays $5,000 a month.

Usagi Akira is a twenty-five-year-old introverted office worker who lives for two things: shojo manga and the spare moments when he can log into his favorite MMO, Tail Earth. There, his avatar is a beautiful bunny girl, and he’s able to go on adventures with the charming wolf-boy Gakuto. When Gakuto asks if Akira wants to meet up IRL for the Tail Earth fan con, Akira agrees. Sparks fly between the two, despite neither of them being quite what the other expected, and they soon fall hard for each other and decide to date! They don’t have much experience when it comes to romance, but this gamer couple is eager to figure it out together.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

It's been 2 years since we started dating.

The two of us have been keeping a good relationship going, but my boyfriend has not laid a hand on me at all. So I cooked up some schemes and resorted to using a hypnosis app on him. I just wanted to know his true feelings. That was all it was supposed to be, but it also awakened the beast within him.

This is a hypnotized yet lovey-dovey manga depicting a couple who were supposed to progress as the girlfriend had hoped, but her manipulation of her boyfriend was a little careless and both of them end up falling more and more to the pleasures of sex.

Gentaro Makino, a former hatamoto (feudal lord), gave up his important position as an accountant and retired early from that business. He has decided to devote himself to "making soba" as his second life. The story is about the life of a former Lord, who is now enjoying a friendly competition to master the art of buckwheat noodle making.

From the world of Trinity Seven comes a sizzling new spinoff!

Yao is a 16-year-old boy who inherited an antique shop left by his grandmother. He also worked as an exorcist, exorcising evil "koware," which are antiques that have been treated with care for many years and have come to possess souls, but whose hearts have been tainted by darkness and attacked people for various reasons. In the past, he was attacked by an antique that contained a "fearsome spirit," which put his sister Meilin in a coma and kept her age at 12. Ever since then, he has been pursuing the koware that attacked her, determined to find the clue that will awaken his sister. But then he was attacked by a koware and nearly died. Yao felt despair, wondering if he would die without accomplishing his goal, when he was rescued by a giant dragon with ancient power!

What is the true nature of this dragon? And where will their encounter lead...?

But that was before she fell in love with Mizoguchi, the vice-president of the students' council. Will she succeed in hiding her true nature? Won-Hyuk’s life is simple: study hard, stay out of trouble, and prepare to study abroad. But everything changes when his alpha stepbrother Han-Seo suddenly reappears. Won-Hyuk wants nothing to do with him, but how does he face someone when his body remembers what his heart wants to forget?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes a prologue.

154151.description:
Ye Kang-Oh is nothing short of royalty in the world of Jianghu. He is the third and youngest disciple of Ye Jin-Rang, the very man who rules over the entire Black Force of Jianghu. Despite being Jin-Rang's favorite disciple and owning promising skills, Kang-Oh intentionally keeps a low profile to keep distance from politics over which disciple will inherit his master's position. One day, Kang-Oh is mysteriously attracted to a humble servant named Woo (Foolishness). Not knowing that their destinies have been tied together since long time ago, Kang-Oh cannot help but continue to get intrigued by this mysterious servant...

Woo is a servant serving Jin-Rang, master of the entire black force of Jianghu. Despite being known as a fair man, Jin-Rang seems to intentionally neglect Woo getting harassed for years by officials of the Black Force. Woo seems to accept such inhumane treatment as his own fate. One day, Woo unintentionally attracts the attention of Kang-Oh, Jin-Rang's youngest and favorite disciple. Woo tries his best to evade Kang-Oh's kindness but at the same time finds it hard to repel the attention of the man he has missed for so long... ever since Kang-Oh was a little boy and Jin-Rang was known as Dan Woo-hyo, the most powerful swordsman in the entire White Force.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

154152.description:
Reborn into a novel, Lulu Ekray knew that she was destined to become the villainess and that she would fall in love with the male protagonist, her obsession with him eventually leading to her execution. Nonetheless, she falls in love with Grand Duke Carlix Rochester anyway, but now, the obsessive one is him! After a night of passion, Lulu gets pregnant, but to avoid becoming the villainess, she decides to leave Carlix. But Lulu has no idea just what lengths Carlix will go to get her back!

(Source: Tapas)

Ma-Seong is a celebrity magician with a profound secret: he can actually move things with his mind! When he runs into a mysterious young woman with amnesia claiming to know him from a past life, Ma-Seong’s existence is upended. Cheon-Dong seems to attract attention wherever she goes, including that of Ma-Seong’s charismatic (but maybe evil) boss, Phillip, and Phillip’s lecherous half-brother, Pil-Yeong. Who is Cheon-Dong, why does she know so much about Ma-Seong, and will they be able to work through more than five centuries of baggage and just fall in love already?

The legend says that Gu Qingcheng was once the wife of Prince Yongjun, but was divorced by her husband. Her whole family was beheaded, and she herself nearly became food in the belly of the beast in the colosseum. She was once the most beautiful woman in the Great Xia Empire, now she's taken away by Prince Sheng. After a year, she's ready to make her comeback, and make the man who destroyed her family pay the price!

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Great Comeback of the Deserted Princess

154159.description:
When six-year-old Inés laid eyes on the handsome heir to House Escalante, she promptly made the boy her fiancé. Since noble men are all the same, she figured she might as well choose a pretty one. But Lord Cárcel isn't ready for this sort of commitment just yet, and he spends the next decade and a half avoiding the marriage at all costs! Luckily, that's no trouble for Inés, as this marriage failing is exactly what she wants. In fact, he has her blessing to sow his wild oats as long as he stays out of her business. Unfortunately, being a playboy isn't as fun when your fiancée gives you permission. And doesn't this mean she's cheating on him too? Now, Cárcel is determined to change Inés' mind about him and prove he can be the husband she's always wanted.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Chiharu is a NEET with no job except for the occasional gig in adult videos. Soon after, she hears news that Yo-Han is studying abroad in the United States. Nak-Won decides to follow him there. To earn money for her plane ticket, she hatches a bold and endearing plan... Meanwhile, Jin-Mi, who seems somewhat mysterious, begins to wander around Nak-Won, hoping to befriend her. Each of them embarks on a journey to find their own movie protagonist. Tatsuya Kageishi's boring life changed to a life of an otaku fan when he saw Aoi Tsubasa, an idol with outstanding singing ability. However, the gal Maika Akabane in his class turned out to be Tsubasa herself, hiding her true identity! But Maika had a problem. If she did not find a boyfriend soon, she will be forced into an arranged marriage and have to retire as an idol. Tatsuya was in despair when he heard the news, but then she asked him to become her fake boyfriend.

To show that they are really lovers, they'll have a lovey-dovey photo shoot, walk to school together, and go to an amusement park on a holiday!
At a live concert, she gave him a secret wink!
Maika, whom he thought was just gal who liked to make fun of others, showed an unexpected side of herself.......

154181.description:
After experiencing trauma at a young age, Iselle Blisha is constantly overprotected by her father and older brother. She spends most of her days confined to the Blisha Estate, only finding freedom during her secret visits to her sculpting master to pass on her blessed works of art. As if her ventures outside aren’t worrying enough for her family, Iselle runs into a bit of trouble one day and gets saved by the bloodthirsty grand duke, Lahan El Canox. And what’s more, Lahan soon visits the estate to ask for Iselle’s hand in marriage! Thankfully, the scary rumors surrounding the grand duke aren’t entirely true, and Lahan just might become the greatest shield of all for the always overprotected Iselle…

(Source: TappyToon)
synonyms: นกน้อยในกรงทอง

154183.description:
Yuzu is a wedding planner who's always ready to tackle her problems head-on. She has feelings for Ojiro, her coworker who trained her. Lately, she's grown concerned that she's unable to understand her clients' needs and suspects the reason is because she doesn't have much experience with love. Therefore, she decides that throwing away her adoration for Ojiro and getting serious about finding a husband will help her grow as a professional!
Hearing her plans, Ojiro begins acting strange... He tells her that if anyone is going to date her, it's going to be him!! Does he want to offer her training on love, including what happens in the bedroom? Or, is he serious about dating her? This is a dreamy love story about two clueless people who, unbeknownst to themselves, are in love with each other!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Ojiro Can't Marry, But His Love Is Intense!
title.native: 結婚できない桜庭先輩の愛がヤバイ！

154184.description: An ordinary office worker was suddenly killed one day and when he wakes up he finds himself in the body of Kisaragi Kotone, an egotistic and affluent young lady who had just been disowned by her family. After inheriting the life of a girl who is despised by everyone around her, he makes a decision to live a normal life. However, because of Kotone's reputation, he finds that his goal will be difficult to achieve.

154186.description:
Rough-looking Hanamaru Odagiri has started dating his childhood friend,Wataru,who is one year younger than him. For Hana,Wataru was like a younger brother,and as a boyfriend,Wataru's sweet personality is both adorable and frustrating. Why? Because they haven't yet started doing the things that lovers do...! Hana wants to kiss,and more. His older brothers,Kiyo,who goes for what he wants,and the baddy wannabe,Take,give him some advice. Under their experienced guidance,Hana leads Wataru into their first taste of adult love!

(Source: Renta!)

154187.description:
Erectile dysfunction caused Jun Hung’s successful life to suddenly come to a halt. After a divorce to his beloved wife, he fell into depression, but with the help of his sister in laws, he found hope again….

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

154188.description:
This manga is based on "My Bullying Diary", an biographical book where Tsuchiya recounts the time when his eldest daughter was a victim of bullying. Part of a project at Weekly Shonen Jump to raise awareness about the bullying issue.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated, edited)

154190.description:
After being threatened by a wasp and breaking through his balcony wall, he finds himself facing his childhood friend in her underwear. Suddenly, he finds his life has a lot more women in it.

"Aren't you curious about my underwear too? I'll show you♡"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

154191.description:
Natsume Hilbright is a girl who had just lost her mother. Even though she was surrounded by her loving father and friends, she still misses celebrating her birthday without her mother. Then, by chance, she met a boy named Jupiter, who claimed to be a prince of the demon world, and a beautiful woman named Glance, who said she was his maid!?

(Source: Comic ZeroSum, translated)

154194.description:
A marriage of convenience shouldn’t stop you from having fun! Playboy lawyer Taeshik’s determined to make his last day as a single man as memorable as possible. A club is the best place for sexy encounters that don’t last, and Taeshik thinks that his one-night stand with Heejoo will be nothing more than a one-night stand…until the next day when he finds out that she’s actually his bride-to-be! This could be an opportunity for him, so he decides to train her to be the one and only bride for him. “I promise I’ll make you happy, so…can you do me a favor?”

(Source: Lezhin X)

154199.description:
Manami, a shoujo manga artist, has always had a strong inferiority complex about herself. Luckily, she met a boyfriend who accepted her for what she was, and it seemed like smooth sailing for her work and private lives. But a minor misunderstanding caused her to start worrying, and then her grandfather, who could read people's auras, told her something even more troubling…

(Source: Cookie, translated)

154201.description:
A modern assassin transmigrated into the body of a weakling in ancient times, but she was unexpectedly blessed with beast-taming powers. She immediately began to fight her way to the top, tearing through the scumbags of the martial arts world. In the meantime, she'll find romance and collect fierce beasts for pets. As she grew in power, she has her sights set on taking over Yunmeng Ze!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

154202.description:
The title story is set in the palace of Knossos in ancient Greece and in the present. The science fiction mystery transcends time and space, tracing the confusion and rebirth of the wounded heart of Kiyora Mogami, a boy genius who discovers the secret of his birth. In addition, there are three more stories that describe the labyrinth of the human mind. "Omae no Yasashii Te de" is set in a wealthy family, depicting the intertwined love-hate conflict between the legitimate heir and the bastard son.

(Source: Fukkan.com, translated)

2-3. Aosaru Ki (青猿記)
4. Ichiyou Raifuku (一陽来復)
5-6. Omae no Yasashii Te de (おまえのやさしい手で)

154204.description:
Kei and Mako have been friends since junior high. Mako was kind to everyone, so he was always surrounded by a crowd of fans. Kei had a crush on Mako, but he was content to stay by his side as a friend. At the high school graduation ceremony, Kei finally confessed his feelings to Mako, only to find out that Mako felt the same way, too. Kei was overjoyed, "We can finally be together!" But then Mako revealed his secret to Kei, that he is a "kami-sama."

(Source: Leed, translated)

154206.description: This is the eighth collection of panpanya's works from Rakuen magazine.

154207.description: With the invention of the steam engine, the industrial revolution occurred and civilization developed really quickly. But people don’t know. An energy source that is tens of thousands of times more efficient than a steam engine has already existed in Jungwon… That is the martial arts. What if the principle of martial arts, which had been hidden by a few established powers from the past, was spread widely to the public by chance… If so, how would have the world change?

154208.description:
Shi Feng was a top player in the online game “God’s Domain” until he was betrayed by his own guild. After a night of drinking to cope with his sorrows, Shi Feng woke up to find himself returned ten years into the past… when “God’s Domain” had just been released. With his past memories and his ten years of game knowledge, Shi Feng will start a new journey back to the pinnacle. This time, he will not be beholden to anyone else. This time, he will climb to even greater heights than before.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Rebirth of the Strongest Sword God

title.english: Reincarnation of the Strongest Sword God

154209.description:
Shushu has entered the chat: her own chat, that is! This modern-day game streamer turned tragic imperial princess has already lived and died twice, and by the third time around, she's hoping to finally break the cycle of rebirth. But God has other plans for her reincarnation, which involve her returning to the very palace that already killed her once before. Thankfully, she isn't reborn without any plot armor at all. Shushu is now blessed with the ability to interact with reality the way she did in her first life: through an online persona. And somehow, the people around her all seem to be avid fans of the stream that is her life. As elements of Shushu's previous lives collide, she'll try using her adorable charm and clever wit to amass loyal followers, rescue an empire, and ultimately beat the game.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: สุ่มกาชามาเป็นองค์หญิง

154210.description:
Seolsuk is the daughter of a lowly provincial worker, and due to her quick wit and tack, she worked as an errand girl for the legitimate spouse of the noble in charge of the province. Lady Wi, the mentioned noble's spouse, asks Seolsuk to become Jinhyo, her adopted son's concubine. Seolsuk's heart flutters in being able to marry Jinhyo, who she had been in love with since childhood. However, she finds out that he was already in love with Pilnam, her other childhood friend, which makes her hesitate accepting Lady Wi's offer. On top of that, Seolsuk is chosen to become a "Gifted Maiden," a title given to prospective brides of the emperor. Will Seolsuk survive in the palace and find love in the upcoming turmoil?

(Source: Copin Comics)

154213.description:
A Virtual Reality game praised for its extreme difficulty.
Hansung was once a top-tier ranker, but he got trapped inside the game!

It’s hard to survive with his current stats. However, Hansung has a high level of luck!

Obtaining SSS class skills from random boxes? That’s easy!
Hitting the jackpot from the slot machine? A piece of cake!

He is overflowing with luck!

So, can Hansung safely clear this game by only relying on his luck?

154215.description:
Welcome to Sedithion, a magical place where dragons, faeries, and demons coexist in peace. It’s also the home of Creserua, the “Twilight Dragon” and the only daughter of the Dragon Lord. Despite this impressive title, Creserua’s physical strength and mana are amongst the weakest of her race. She may not be completely content, but at least her pharmacological talents let her excel above her peers. She’s only just reconciled with the idea that nothing will change for a dragon as weak as herself, until one day...she wakes up next to three familiar figures. Her childhood friend, a faerie she’s grown estranged from, and her demon co-researcher. Not only that, but she’s pregnant with no idea who the father is!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: This series originally released as a R15 version but rereleased as a R19 version in 2024 after the series completed. The R15 version is completed with 80 chapters while the R19 version is completed with 107 chapters.

154216.description: "Why don't you see me as a woman?" Ha-yoon, who smiles brightly at Shin Hwi but tastes the humiliation, But there's no giving up in her dictionary! Sung Ha-yoon, a crazy foal who is fighting to become a woman of Moon Shin-hwi. Can't you just stop moving on...?

I want to be your woman

154218.description:
Betrayed by her betrothed and bullied by her family, a young noblewoman named Charlotte Evans flees her home and stumbles into the hands of Allen Crawford, a misanthropic wizard known as the Dark Lord who lives in a solitary mansion deep in the forest. When he hears the sad story of Charlotte’s pitiful life, he discovers a new calling—giving her a crash course in all things naughty, from late-night feasts of cake and ramen to sleeping in till the afternoon, from dressing up in cute outfits to fun-filled days at the beach! Allen is determined to pamper Charlotte with every irresistible pleasure imaginable. Will he succeed in healing her emotional trauma and building up her confidence? And is there anything special between this odd couple? Here begins the tale of a wicked sorcerer who leads an innocent girl astray...down the path of pure self-indulgence!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

154219.description:
Mars, a young man who was reborn in another world, is traveling with his elf slave, Lilia. His goal is to conquer the world's seven greatest dungeons and obtain the "Tome of Forbidden Magic," which contains powers beyond comprehension. However, he tends to fall behind in his questing because he is busy making love to Lilia...... all day every day. What adventures await them as they take their own sweet time journeying toward their goal?

(Source: Dash X Comics)

154221.description:
Corporate drone Kazama Masato just wants to get his work done and go home, but there’s a new employee who’s making things hard for him. Inami Nagisa is friendly, competent, a fast learner…and even kind of cute. But she annoys the heck out of Masato, especially with all her teasing and flirting. As the senpai, he should be above it all, but her words and actions are especially grating. It can’t possibly be that he’s into her, though…can it?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

154222.description:
With their nations in conflict, the Hero Reid and the Sage Elria had long been on opposing sides of the battlefield. However, it would all come to a much too sudden end with the Sage's passing. Single-handedly breaking through the enemy ranks to see Elria one last time, Reid meets his own heroic demise...

But then, he opens his eyes as a newborn a thousand years later, getting another chance at life…and love?!

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

Mie is a dull high school student who happens to be a professional manga author. He hires an assistant, but the person who came is the number one gal in his class! Despite her looks though, she's extremely good at what she does, and working with her is exciting, stimulating, busy, and fun!!

154235.description:
Out of nowhere, Ryosuke Kamijo, the student council president, came and asked me, Yuga Asami, out. Whatever... I'll just see where this goes... Up till now, every guy I've been with just wanted to drink and sleep together. But this one's different... He's throwing me way off my game...

154258.description:
Reborn into a world of immortal cultivation, Han Jue found himself blessed with the Gacha System, able to re-roll for stats in cultivation and luck. To stay out of trouble, Han Jue cultivated on his own, and kept quiet about his special abilities. But when his sect faced destruction, he stepped up to defend it. A thousand years later, after many generations of cultivation, the immortals were planning to cleanse the mortal realm, and Han Jue was finally forced to act. That was when he discovered that even gods and immortals were not as powerful as he had imagined…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

154259.description:
Three years ago, three magical spirits fell from the heavens. The king of the eastern Qin received one, and he conquered the six eastern kingdoms into one empire. The warlord of the southern wastes received the second, and he united the nineteen sects to become the leader of the southern plains. Sun Changming received the third, and three years later, nothing in his ordinary life has changed. But it turned out that the little mudfish he picked up three years before was actually the most powerful magical beast of all! Once it evolves, its abilities are so overpowering that nothing will stand in his way!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Lin Jing was a teenage girl with a mysterious background. A human, vampire, or an angel? Which is her true form?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

154261.description:
He was once known as the Blade Of China, the mightiest soldier in the military, a member of the Tianjian special forces. He set up shop in the criminal scene in the West, quickly becoming known as the fearsome Lord Of The Underworld.

"My name is Liu Feng. I am good at two things: killing and healing. Anyone I want to heal, not even the devil can take. Anyone I want to kill, god won't be able to save."

(Source: Tencent, translated)

154262.description:
Via and Gra have always been teased for being together since high school. Via is a love expert and on the other hand Gra is like a eunuch who has never had an erection for anyone except for Via. Via registers him for a love tour. Finally, Gra has met his partner! And now Via is checking in with Gra on this love tour she forced him to attend….

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

synonyms: พักร้อนมาพบรัก

154265.description:
After being together for 9 years, Geurim and her boyfriend had lost their spark, leading her to travel to Paris on a package holiday on impulse. Upon her arrival at the airport, Geurim had been waiting for her luggage when she spotted it and reached out her hand… but it brushed against another belonging to a handsome man, who had reached out for the same luggage. Geurim decided to put her excitement aside and enjoy her trip instead, but the man assigned as her partner turned out to be terrible! He didn’t seem to like her either, and went away. In the meantime, Geurim bumped into the man from the airport, who unexpectedly proposed to go around together… Will the two of them be able to stand by themselves by the end of this?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

It's time to start appreciating older men!
Cool men, dandy men, elegant men.
They each have a secret, hidden side—.
In this anthology, you'll see the "cute" side of these guys, and it'll surely make you swoon!

(Source: Bookwalker, translated)

154270.description:
20 years after an unsolved mass murder mystery, a billionaire falls terminally ill and the only regret he has is that he hasn't killed enough. He calls upon his 17 offspring in order to play a game of 'KILLS', a popular mobile game... in real life.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

154272.description:
Vengeful spirit is a mass of emotions that clings to this world with a grudge. In the growing modern world, vengeful spirits with various "grudges" were born, and there were also exorcists who specialized in that particular field. The wild "shitty big emotion" that the exorcist Osamu faces is... a fangirl?! She loves manga and anime, and she calms raging spirits. A gag series featuring a contemporary exorcist!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: The chapter count contains 3 extra chapters.

154273.description:
Cat-rearing college student x hamster-rearing salaryman

Despite the fact that his ex-girlfriend left due to him constantly doing overtime at the company, Naoe Yoshihito doesn't think of himself as being enslaved by his company. Between living for his job and providing for his beloved hamster Hanako, one thing that always helps relieve his stress is following the social media account of a cat named Goma. But it turns out that his favourite cat-idol and their owner is much closer than he'd ever imagine...?

synonyms: How to spend a long night

154275.description: Soo-Hee grew up trapped in a household preaching about an old-policy that women must be submissive and modest. And at the age of 29, she left. Using an app on her phone for the first time in her life, she got connected with a man, whose personality and voice were her type. And during their first phone call... "Your voice makes me so horny. The moment I heard your voice, I just wanted to do things like this." She moaned silently as an attempt to suppress her moaning, she buried her head in her blanket. The man patiently waited for Soo-Hee's response, and as soon as she got quiet, he finally spoke. "Now put your hand down there."

154276.description: Mimiel, a mysterious girl who fell from the sky, is taken in by Ren, a high schooler. She claims to be a fallen one-winged angel, stripped of her angelhood due to her inability to love humans. Ren decides to begin living with Mimiel until the day she knows love and is able to go back to heaven once again.

154277.description:
People become primal beasts, give up rational thought, and celebrate their freedom in anonymity.

This is the "Masked City."

It is a town where anyone can casually transform into a beast by taking a "monster supplement" and do whatever they want. It is the only government-approved "slum" where one can forget the stifling atmosphere of a completely monitored society. In this town, a vampire boy named Zero, who was a real monster, and his werewolf partner Tsuki take on the job of "exterminating vermin" as street cleaners. They search for hit-and-run centaurs, hunt JK bunnies, and fight to the death against an urban legend that has emerged. An encounter with the "Medicine Witch" will change the destiny of Zero and his friends.

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

154279.description:
Arisa Sanaka is a naive, sheltered girl, the daughter of a famous film director. She seemed far out of reach, but I, Yukito Kurosawa, an ordinary classmate, "picked her up" and took her in to live with my sister in our house.

"I've decided to run away from home. I might be willing to be picked up by you, Kurosawa-kun."

For some reason, even my sister got into the act, making her wear a dog-eared maid outfit.
And so began our daily life with Arisa....... She wakes me up in the morning, helps with the housework, goes to the riverside in the swimsuit I chose for her, and offers me a lap pillow in her pajamas at night.

"Would you pat my head as a reward! Master-sama?"

At school, she's the "unattainable flower," but at home, she's a "dog-eared girl looking for headpats."
This is a romantic comedy about living together with a girl that is so sweet you'll almost melt.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

154280.description:
Naruto Toyama was a world-renowned explorer, until he got involved in an incident and died. When he woke up as if guided by a mysterious voice, he found himself in a different world. He was forced into slavery and was about to be used as bait for demons, but he escaped with his unique ability "Kiriyaiba" and the skills he had cultivated as an explorer. He even defeated Alice, the covetous dragon who had ended so many lives, so she wanted him to marry her and become her mate.

However, Toyama's answer was "No".
"The decision is not yours to make. I will be the only one who decides my own fate according to my own desires."

Act 1 of the isekai fantasy drama of the greedy adventurer favored by a dragon!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

154281.description:
Isamu Arizuki (28) returned to his hometown after quitting his job at an black company in Tokyo. Just as he was getting ready to start a new life back home, he met a beautiful and innocent JK girl, who turned out to be Haruyama Miya, one of the little girls (brats) Isamu used to play with when he was young. But Isamu didn't recognize her because of how much she had changed after growing up.......?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

154282.description:
Ars, the son of a an imperial aristocrat, was blessed by the gods with the gift of "hearing".
However, the only effect of this gift seemed to be "better hearing," and so Ars was branded as useless and imprisoned in a tower sealed with a ward!? However, while imprisoned, Ars realized that he could hear the incantation spoken by the mages. And he could even hear the chants of the gods in the heavens with his extraordinary hearing, and this allowed him to learn legendary magic.

Before he knew it, he had become the most powerful being in the world!

More than ten years after his imprisonment, Ars broke the seal of his prison and entered the outside world in search of more magic he has yet to learn. However, the naive Ars was unaware of the full power of his extraordinary abilities...?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

154283.description:
When Kaito Sickino attended the funeral of a relative, he ended up taking in four orphaned sisters. And that was when he recalled his previous life and realized that he was in a game world. He also realized that if he followed the plot, the four sisters, Chiharu, Chinatsu, Chiaki, and Chifuyu, who have had an unfortunate life up until now, will have to face an even more unfortunate future.

Kaito decided that he must help the four sisters to be happy!

The happy days spent with Kaito helped to ease the wounds and worries of each girl. Kaito's warm and sincere words open the hearts of the four sisters, all living under one roof, each with their own unique personality!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

154285.description:
"If I get you pregnant, you'll have no choice but to be my wife."

The boy who suddenly appeared before Rin is her fiance!? But his true form is that of a man-eating demon. Rin's parents passed away when she was little and she has been living with her brother ever since, caring for the family shrine. One day, she meets a transfer student, Suo Kusa. He kisses the birthmark on her neck as he exclaims "I finally found you...!"

Suo tells her that they're childhood friends and he moved back to town to see her, but she doesn't remember anything. Then she ends up witnessing his true form... that of a demon!

"It's your fate to become my wife!" he whispers as he pulls her close...

(Source: Renta!)

Youko Kihara makes the resolution to say goodbye to her longtime affair partner after seeing her friend's marriage. Later on she gets ambushed by him in front of her house, and is saved by Fujiwara, a resident of the same apartment. Fujiwara snuggles up to Youko, who is filled with anxiety, until she falls asleep...? He says he will sleep with her when she is unable to sleep in the future.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

154287.description:
Lanokuma is a town outside of the peaceful royal capital. Lucy is a doctor that just started working in the order of knighthood. Even though she should be working exclusively for those within the subdivision, since she is not extremely busy, so she also takes time to interact and take care of the townspeople.

One day at work, Lucy hears that the new king will come and observe them, and everyone is hyped-up. Then, on her way back home, she comes across an unknown injured man! Considering that he's hurt, she can't just leave him, so she takes him back to her own home. His name turns out to be Harold, and he's a good-looking man with purple eyes, but is that all there is to him...?

(Source: Renta!)

Leaving her hometown to study at Wuhan High School, young Xiaoxi did not expect such a drastic change. Lost in the hustle and bustle of this big city, she feels less herself, less gifted and less legitimate than her classmates. Her meeting with Yan Huan, the most beautiful girl in the school, and Lin'an, the brilliant student, will allow her to flourish in this new environment, but will also confront her with the emotions of adolescence...

Little does he know, that when he does eventually accept the offer, it is but the beginning of the rest of his life, and the college's obscurity will be the least of his concerns once they start telling him about the dragons...

154299.description:
Louise, a noble lady who loves reading and researching magic tools, leads a double life pretending to be her twin sister. Suddenly one day, her fiance breaks off their engagement and chooses to be with her sister instead. All seems lost to her when she also has to give up her dream of becoming a magic tool researcher, but a reunion with her first love, the first prince Lucius, saves her from her misery. As they spend time together reading books in the hidden archives and looking around at different magic tool shops, Louise slowly regains her confidence. On top of that, her heart flutters every time unconsciously sweet words leave the prince's mouth. The mood is perfect and it seems like it's seconds before they can finally be together, but the past she wants to keep hidden gets in the way. "How...do you feel about me?" He asks, but...I can't do it. I can't tell him. Meanwhile, her potential as a researcher begins to blossom and leads to...A true love fantasy full of misunderstandings between a magic tool-obsessed noble lady and a stoic older prince awaits!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

I, Saki Ayase, am a serious person. Ever since I was little, I listened to my mom, practiced hard, and everyone praised my performances. I also studied hard to become an "honor student" that everyone admired.

I want to get better and better and become a great actress when I grow up!

I was so sure that my dream would come true.

However, I was told that my "honor student" performances lacked that spark, and my work as a child actress gradually dwindled. Encouraged by the fan letters, I continued to work hard without giving up, but... when I saw Rena Nanase's performance, I understood, "Ah, so that's what a genius looks like."

A troubled elite's coming-of-age struggle to look forward once again!

154333.description:
The protagonist, Yamashiro Koyomi, had graduated university and undertook the teacher employment exam in order to become a high school teacher, her dream job. However, her attempts had constantly ended up in failure.

"Maybe I'm not fit to be a teacher?" As the protagonist thought this and was about to give up, she had finally received a report indicating that she had passed.

Her heart leapt at the thought of her new life as a teacher. The school that had employed her is located in the 48th prefecture of Japan known as the Aima Prefecture, and is a training school designed to educate inexperienced UMA so that they can become fully-fledged UMA. In fact, Koyomi had accidentally undertaken the "animal trainer" employment exam instead of the "teacher" exam!

"This is impossible for me," said Koyomi, as she was about to decline her offer of employment. In response to this, the school's principal promised, "if you can can work admirably for us for one year, I'll put in a good word for you to other high schools."

Having no experience whatsoever in the art of training, will Koyomi be able to train an UMA? Also, will she be able to assist in the growth of an inexperienced UMA into an excellent one?

For the sake of being able to transfer to a different high school- though filled with her doubts- Koyomi's year-long life as a homeroom teacher-cum-"animal trainer" will begin!

A smart, athletic, who handles anything perfectly and unequaled beautiful girl, dies young due to a car accident. And now, while possessing the memories of her previous life, is reincarnated in a fantasy-ish world with swords and magic!

In this world all lives were dependent on magicians, however, their numbers decreased every year due to the magic power scattered around the world running out, thus the reliance on magic was coming to an end.

This is a story that will lead to the life of a girl relying on the knowledge of her previous life, as she proposes a way to live even without the use of magic while seeking for what it is, and aiming for a wealthier life.

"Misaki Kanda" and "Kousuke Hatsuoka" are childhood friends and lovers. The two of them have been dating each other for 3 years already, but they've only gone as far as kissing...

Kousuke has tried many times to initiate going further but she always refuses.
Misaki is interested, but she just keeps refusing because of embarrassment.

He used to be smarter but ever since they started dating, Kousuke's grades have been getting worse.
As a result, Misaki feels bad for making him put up with her, so she takes the first step!

This is the story up to his first time having sex with his childhood friend, a bashful high school girl who's blessed with both beauty and brains.

A 3rd year high school student named Honoka Miyamae and her teacher named Ryouma Kiryuu are cousins and they are very close. Both of them are keeping this a secret, due to the possibility of him getting a job transfer if people around them were to find out.

Honoka, who is trying to make her feelings of affection reach Ryouma, often comes over to his house in the neighborhood where he lives alone, where she tries to appeal to him; but she just can't quite get him to lay a hand on her...

One day, Honoka's parents were fighting again which made it hard for her to be at home, so she finds herself staying at Ryouma's house for longer than usual; In order to get him to see her as a woman rather than a cousin, she begins her "approach" and follows him into the bath!

"Big sis" Mifuyu is licking her lips at the sight of this naive boy who's just her type. This devilish older girl first checks to make sure that Miyuki is out of the house, and then makes her move on Shouta...!!

Rita is Convict 999, a former legendary assassin who now works at a kindergarten for the children of world leaders. Her job is to protect the schoolchildren from the clutches of would-be assassins sent after them! But even with her overwhelming strength, Rita has a weakness—she’s head-over-heels for good-looking men! 

(Source: Yen Press)

154350.description:
Succubi, a species that uses humans as seedbeds to reproduce, and humanity, which is set on the eradication of every single succubus. As the unrelenting war between these two incompatible groups wages on, a “king” who will bring about the end of the war is born. The one chosen for the role of king is…?!From an author with a unique background as a CG artist in Hollywood, comes an extraordinary piece of entertainment that is sure to rock the world!

(Source: K Manga)

154351.description:
The epic and foreboding world of the award-winning video game Elden Ring gets turned on its head in this absurd comedy adventure! Follow Aseo the Tarnished as he begins his journey through the Lands Between on the long, looong road to becoming the next Elden Lord. What Aseo lacks in strength, speed, intelligence, charisma, skill, experience, intuition, and common sense, he makes up for in...uhhh…

(Source: Yen Press)

After being turned down by his crush at work, he suddenly finds himself set to marry her and work at her family business. But thus business is not what it seems... A woman comes to his room at night.

"I'm not very good at it but..."

(Source: TOPTOON+)

154355.description:
Hira has always dreaded the first day of new classes. Ever since he was little, he's had a stutter that only worsens when he's anxious, causing Hira to always sink to the bottom of the social pyramid. This year of his high school career might not have been any different if it weren't for him: Kiyoi, the most beautiful and kingly man Hira has ever seen. Normally, their lives would never intersect, but Hira suddenly gets a chance to grow closer with Kiyoi when he's made the popular group's gofer and gets Kiyoi's phone number! Hira treasures every order Kiyoi gives him and every bit of change he's handed to run errands... Is this what they call love?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

154356.description: Deep, deep in the mountains, there was a village that was skilled at craftsmanship; even the nobility partook in the business of creation. However, their princess is clumsy with her hands. Despite this, she wants to find a way to help the village she loves.

154357.description:
Haru Yonezawa is an outstanding office manager who is looked up to by all of his teammates. On the surface, he is cool and collected, never getting his feathers ruffled by his grouchy boss. But the truth is he has a secret hobby that, if anyone found out about, would destroy his elite image. Every night, after a long, stressful day at work, he unwinds by dressing up and roleplaying… as a dog. Looking for a new “master” to help meet his needs, he calls upon a call-girl, who shows up and is none other than one of his subordinates from work!

(Source: Mangamo)

154358.description: This is a one-off remake of Grappler Baki's chapter 1, created in honour of Weekly Shounen Champion's 50th publication anniversary.

154359.description:
Toru Usui was transferred from the city office to a museum, where he had a shocking encounter with with Akari Kiyosu, an ornithologist. What happens behind-the-scenes at a museum, where their jobs will pay off 100 years later?

"I love this! I want to find out!"

For the first time in his life, Usui's heart was touched, by working with these extraordinary researchers, who live by these words!

(Source: Big Comic Bros, translated)

154360.description:
Wu Weiwei's mother passed away, but instead of grief, she feels anger towards her father. Due to the Wu family abandoning them, she wants revenge by being engaged to Ye Group's CEO. As she schemes to bring the Wu family to ruin, romance unexpectedly blooms for her.

(Source: INKR)

You Are Sunshine Warm Me Up

154361.description:
After a night of drinking, aspiring civil servant Ryu Gunwoo passes out, only to awaken three years in the past in the body of a young man named Park Moondae. Before he can even assess the situation, he's given a mission: Debut or Die! Now, Moondae has one year to debut as an idol or face his doom. Luckily, he's able to snag a spot on the famous survival program "Idol Inc.", but with his skills so low and the competition so high, does Moondae stand a chance at becoming a shining star?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

After transmigrating into a world of magic, Qin Chuan who was a Sichuan Cuisine Chef discovers his food is key to boosting combativity. With demons rampaging the land, it’s about time to put an end to the misery and suffering. Who's to say a chef can’t save the world? But why are the heroes super hot babes?

To become a painter in an era of prejudice, Chae Hong-Kyeong disguises herself as a boy and leaves for Gyeongseong. Despite her hatred of cameras, she’s drawn to the photos she sees at a studio called Inbyeoldang. After an interesting encounter with its owner, Ju-Heon, Hong-Kyeong accepts his offer to learn photography and work at the studio, which is on the brink of collapse. Will she fulfill her dreams, survive her new job, and most importantly, keep her true identity secret from her boss?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Nohara-san was seated next to me when we changed seats in class. Her hair is very beautiful, but she is clumsy and can't seem to tie it herself...?

Haruki, who helps to do his sister's hair every morning, suddenly found himself helping Nohara with her hair. As he tied her precious hair, they gradually became more and more aware of each other and grew closer. Untying and tying, their hearts are woven together like strands of hair.

She was called the Dragon Princess by her people, sometimes with contempt, and sometimes with reverence. But 700 years before the Empire's cannon pierced the dragon's breast, there was another girl. Threatened by an evil dragon, the people of a small kingdom formed a pact with a Divine Dragon and flourished under its protection. Brunhild is born into the house of the Dragon Priestesses—the only ones in the land who can understand the dragon's words. Like her mother and her mother's mother before her, she serves the Divine Dragon, cleaning his temple, listening to his sacred words, and gratefully offering him tribute: seven people every month.

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: The setting is 700 years before the first published novel.

154372.description:

A death game then unfolds in "mixed reality."

(Source: Crunchyroll)

154374.description:
The protagonist "Ryou Tomosaka" quit his club after he got injured and now lives an unremarkable daily life.
One day, his friend "Sousuke Saimi" showed him an incredible app.

— It was a Hypnosis app. —

The two of them were leaving after school intending to try it out downtown, when Ryou gets called out for cleaning duty by "Sakura Iioka", the public morals committee head. On their way to the place that needed cleaning, he thought there's no way something like hypnosis would work. But out of sheer curiosity he ends up trying it on her...

A catastrophic event has thrust the world into an age where disease begets disease. Ostracized for his unconventional treatment methods, the dark Doctor Ikuru is stricken with an immortalizing disease. On a desperate mission to die, he must save a world desperate to live. This medical science-fiction adventure will go to the very edge of humanity and back in one man's search for an ending to his suffering, all while saving the world he wishes to leave.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

154377.description:
Kazuki is a janitor who can only afford to rent rooms in net-cafes to pass the night. His only hobby is drawing. One day, a strange young man asks to buy his doodles......? An encounter through a window will change the course of his life...!

In the picturesque town of Kuraoka in Fukui Prefecture, the Kuraoka Sake Brewery has been making sake since the Edo period. Akane Kamio, who inherited the brewery after her father's sudden death, converted part of the brewery into a small ryokan called "Kura no Yado."

(Source: Shukan Manga Times, translated)

154379.description:
One day, the high school girl Minon's beloved brother suddenly disappeared. All he left behind was an email note that he had been taken hostage by "A," a known serial-killer, and something about a mysterious place called "Eimugai." In order to get to that place, which did not appear in any searches, Minon tried to sneak into a suspicious building where she last saw her brother. However, it turned out to be the entrance to a forbidden place that must never be entered. This is a suspenseful search-and-rescue drama, as she entered a nest of "great evil" which will exceed all common sense and human understanding!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

154380.description:
First-year university student Honoka feels intimidated and left out by her friends who have pulled off their college debuts. After a certain incident, she finds herself drawn to Iida-kun, a classmate from her 'spiritual oasis', the Ancient Research Club (aka 'Koken'), and rapidly grows closer to her upperclassman, Kanie-san!? Honoka, who tormented herself for being unremarkable, gradually grows through her time in Koken.

A clumsy and endearing love story brought about by ancient tombs.

154382.description:
The Public Face of a Noble’s Spoiled Son. He Secretly Dominates and Thrives in the Shadows... But His True Identity Was Exposed!!!???

The "Shadow Hero." A man who appears in crises and battlefields across various nations, using his exceptional magic to save people before vanishing in the blink of an eye. His true identity was supposed to be completely shrouded in darkness... or so it was thought.

"My identity was exposed!!!"

Phil Salemabard, a young noble with a notoriously bad reputation, has been secretly active as the "Shadow Hero" for personal reasons, but one day his true identity gets revealed in the city. Despite his attempts to cover it up, noble young ladies, an adorable saint, and even the princess of the nation—girls who feel indebted to the "Shadow Hero"—begin to approach him one after another!?

154387.description:
A young girl lives on the northern tip of the Yamato archipelago in the land of Enishi. Her name is Kaya Fugeki, a descendant of the family that serves the Agents of the Four Seasons who has now found herself ascended to take on similar responsibilities as them. She is the one who brings day to Yamato-the Archer of Dawn. The young goddess mingles with the commonfolk as she attends school, yet nobody except for the handsome young man who serves her knows she is the country’s Day. Herein begins Kaya and Yuzuru’s story.

(Source: Yen Press)

154388.description:
A cute little brother suddenly became a beast.

Yusuke and Tokio are brothers living together in their parents' house. One night they have an unexpected encounter in the city, and their secrets are revealed: Yusuke is gay, and Tokio is bi. Even though it was a shocking discovery, Yusuke keeps trying to play the good older brother, while the younger brother Tokio can't look at him in the same light anymore.

The love battle between a poker-faced brother and one that has a soft spot for bad men begins!

(Source: Renta!, translated and edited)

154389.description: It's a story about she-male elves cavorting with a human boy at a hot spring.

154390.description:
Inori is a college student who had a fear of men due to a traumatic experience. When Inori got into trouble one day, she was rescued by Riku, a junior high school student. Inori thought that it was cute for little Riku to want to act like an adult, but Riku has fallen seriously in love with Inori. However, Inori's younger sister, Kasumi, also has a crush on Riku...?

(Source: B Komi, translated)

154394.description:
A tale surrounding the mystical power known as "the Cabal" takes three adventurers on a journey to become Cabalists.

(Source: Toomics)

154396.description:
A tale of two brothers from ancient Greece, Grenos and Huros, trained together in the ways of Pankration - a martial art combining boxing and wrestling - since they were old enough to walk. While still young, fate tears the two apart when their island home of Lemnos is invaded by Spartians, razing the town and killing everyone in their path... The Spartans take Huros prisoner and sell Grenos into slavery. Now, left with naught but a thirst for strength and a promise to his older brother, Grenos struggles to survive as a slave and one day reunite with Huros at the Olympic games.

(Source: Mangamo)

title.native: ロバストネス ～Road to Olympia～

154397.description:
"Can I be your bride once again?"

On the eve of her wedding with Koushiro, whom she has loved since childhood, Mio lost her life in a car accident. However, by divine providence, she was reborn as Sakura, a person carrying Mio's memories but with a different appearance. The condition for continuing her second life is to become Koushirou's bride once again, but without being recognized as Mio...?

(Source: Betsucomi Flower)

154398.description:
Xiao Qiu anonymously defended humanity with all his strength, but he remained unappreciated and misunderstood by everyone. After a life of tragedy, he died and was reborn. This time, he will discard his humanity, and begin his journey to become an unrepentant monster.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: I Have to Be a Monster

154400.description:
Akira is the daughter of the CEO at a newspaper company, and she works there as the editor-in-chief. She is respected by her subordinates for her perfect work ethic, but outside work, she has no life skills at all! She survives on bentos and beer from the convenience store, littered around her messy home. One day, she ran into Kyosuke, a young man who had collapsed at the entrance of her apartment. When Akira took him in, he begged her with the gaze of an adoring puppy, "Please, I have nowhere else to go..." He turned out to be good at housework, so she decided to hire him as a live-in housekeeper! However, Kyosuke has a hidden side, with secrets of his own...? Be careful of his duality! A dangerous love story between a puppy-dog young man and a career-woman inexperienced at love, living together under one roof.

(Source: Mecha Comic, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes an after-episode.
