Washing dishes were a pain so he decided to make someone else do it. But he didn't expect a beautiful woman to show up! It started with dishwashing, but he also had other chores in mind.

(Source: DAYcomics)
synonyms: きゅうりフリマ～アプリで出会った女達～

154405.description:
Ha-Yun, who was struggling on his own, rescued a Persian cat who got almost hit by a car.
It was a good deed without any special intention, but the cat brought along a long-haired woman lying naked in front of his house.
Ha-Yun misunderstood her as a fan and tried to kick her out. However, she insisted that she was the guardian angel and persisted to stay around Ha-Yun.
She speaks and acts very differently from ordinary people.
Due to a weird situation, Ha-Yun is forced to hire her as a manager and live together. Also with blue, the cat that brought her along.
But the more he looks at this woman, the more vague it becomes. Is she really... an angel?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

154406.description:
A man who got a divorce from his wife has to live with her again!

"Hey... can I sleep next to you...?"

Can they fall in love with each other one more time?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

154407.description:
Doctor Hong Gye-Dong has mysterious eyes that can see people's threads of life. Actually, Hong Gye-Dong is a woman. One day, due to unavoidable circumstances, she ends up getting caught while shifting a drink bill to a man she thought was a scholar. Entangled with a dangerous man whose thread of life she can't even see, Hong Gye-Dong enters the medical clinic of the royal family.

But as it turns out, the man Hong Gye-Dong thought was a common scholar is actually the King.

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

154408.description:
Jun Yu, a WBA lightweight champion, gets dumped by his girlfriend, then gets hit by a car… and wakes up in a dating simulation game as Yu-Jun Russell, the adopted DAUGHTER of a noble family! The game tells Jun that he can be reincarnated, but only after playing to win over the love of his target characters. Determined to see his ex-girlfriend again, he eagerly accepts the challenge. Will Jun be successful in winning the hearts of his suitors, and manage to return to the world he came from?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

154409.description:
After being hit by a car, Im Jinhyuk spends a long time in a coma, only to magically awaken in the past, the day before things all began to go downhill for his family. While unconscious, Jinhyuk lived as the almighty Heavenly Demon, Chunma, and now that he's back in the modern world, he's brought Chunma's abilities back with him! Determined to ensure a different fate for himself and his family, Jinhyuk uses his powers to master his father's recipes and help make their bakery the best in town!

(Source: Tapas)

154410.description:
Even the most casual of comments can leave some people with profound scars. One cruel sentence has left Jae-Ha with a chronic fear of talking to strangers, while another remark has turned Yeong-U into a recluse. A little bit of coincidence and a pinch of nosiness bring the two boys together, marking the beginning of an unlikely friendship. Together, they try to face their demons head on. All they need to do to move on is to take everything one step at a time. One small step, that’s all it’ll take. One small step to start.

(Source: Lezhin US)

154411.description:
World-renowned actress Son Yu-Ri has it all: beauty, talent, and now even unimaginable wealth upon her marriage to IT magnate, Dave Cheon. But the happiest day of Yu-Ri’s life soon becomes the worst when her husband suddenly goes missing after the first night of their honeymoon. With them having been the only two on their yacht in the middle of the vast sea, Yu-Ri is immediately suspected of murdering Dave. Just when the entire world seems to be against her, Yu-Ri is reunited with Lee Do-Jun, a lawyer and old acquaintance. Despite their complicated history and disadvantage in the case, Do-Jun is determined to prove Yu-Ri’s innocence by uncovering the truth behind this impossible mystery…

(Source: Tappytoon)

154413.description:
Ye Woo-Ju has all but given up on remembering who he is after a terrible accident leaves him with amnesia. But he's hit with a cold hard case of déjà vu when illustrious actor Lee Young-Won shows up on his doorstep. While the film star claims to be an old friend, a few steamy encounters suggest their relationship went far deeper than that. Now, with his supposed ex-lover being the epitome of everything he once aspired to be, Woo-Ju starts to think maybe his old self is worth remembering. But what if the past holds such dark secrets that forgetting was the only way to move on? As Woo-Ju grapples with his trauma and a celebrity heartthrob determined to win him over, reigniting the flame he and his friend once shared might just be the key to remembering his true self.

(Source: Tappytoon)

For all his life, Lee Dan has often found himself abandoned. It began with being left in a box outside as a baby and most recently when his boyfriend and roommate cheated on him. While feeling lost on the streets, he is picked up by Yeo Jeongheon, who allows Dan to stay at his place for as long as he requires. Since Jeongheon is an alpha, his intentions of bringing home Dan, an omega, seem obvious. But when Dan offers to repay him with his body, Jeongheon firmly rejects him and instead tries to care to his every need. This confuses Dan as the only alphas he’s encountered are ones who tried to take advantage of him. Perhaps Jeongheon has some other hidden motives, or he actually could be the sweetest alpha Dan has ever met…

(Source: Tappytoon)

154714.description:
Lacrosse is the fastest fighting ball game on earth. There are no professional teams in Japan for this sport, and volunteer adult teams compete fiercely to become the best in Japan. One of the adult teams, "Ablaze," has seen a dramatic decrease in team members due to work and family circumstances! In this critical situation, a complete amateur with no experience steps in...!? A first in Japan! A classic sports manga that depicts the passionate game of men's lacrosse begins!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

154716.description:
In Mushizuka Town, where fate and history intertwine, lives 14-year-old Arisu Haguro. She bears a sad burden as the miko of a local shrine dedicated to insects.

One day, a transfer student appears before her with the wings of a dragonfly on his back. Identifying himself as Managuro, a familiar spirit who serves the miko, his arrival brings an abrupt end to Arisu's mundane days.

A connection between humans and insects has existed for ages. Standing at the boundary between grudges and salvation, Arisu must face her fate.

154725.description:
Taiki Aoba, a 195cm tall junior high student, gets treated like a "mutant" when he plays basketball with other boys because of his physique. He was starting to doubt his "self" when he met Leo, the star of Japan's U16 national team. He told Taiki that his true weapon was not his height, but his "eyes," the talent to make the split-second decisions 1-on-1. Taiki was drawn to the freedom of basketball that Leo talked about, which does not judge a player by just his height. Now with a dream to surpass Leo, Taiki enters Aorei High School, a top basketball school in Tokyo!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

An invisible person, a werewolf, a dracula, a medusa, a naga, a mummy, and a franken.

These seven monster teenagers grow up as they wrestle with and learn about friendship, love, and family through each other. A series featuring these monsters, illuminated by a gentle moonlight.

154730.description:
“I'll show you my prodigal ways!”

I’m Li JinLong, and I’ve just reincarnated from present-day China to the Ming Dynasty! Everyone here has reincarnated themselves, and it’s all to fight monsters and level up?! Here’s the thing. They all have powers, while all I have is me, myself, and my money. With competition this fierce, how am I supposed to rise through the ranks and become the best fighter in the Ming Dynasty??

154731.description:
Chikako Sugata is a 32-year-old "sudachi" (a sour lemon), who spent her twenties in the countryside without any romantic relationships. She finally decided to move to Tokyo to rediscover her youth! To have one last memorable occasion before leaving, she went to a bar at midnight and had a one-night stand with a man from her home town...!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

154732.description:
Dalsu, the son of God, has been kicked out of the afterworld and sent to Earth on a mission: find out what makes humans truly happy. Teamed up with his friend Lisa, who happens to be an angel and talented chef, the two start a food delivery service. Because what could make humans happier than delivery food? Only when the happiness meter on his motorcycle hits 100% will he be allowed to return. Will Dalsu be able to make it back to the heavens?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

154733.description:
Being a famous celebrity isn’t easy, especially when you have no family to share your success with. After her mom’s death, A-list actress Han Nana is left all alone and in a total career slump. In comes Yoo Sungwoo, a high school senior and orphan who used to be close to Nana before her big break. Although Nana takes him in as a sort of younger brother, the longer they live together, the more apparent it becomes that Sungwoo doesn’t just think of her as an older sister. Meanwhile, Nana’s career starts looking up when she’s given a lead role in an upcoming romance drama. The only problem is that her counterpart is Lee Han, the famous actor who was once the root of Nana’s despair, though he doesn’t seem so cold to her this time around…

(Source: Tappytoon)

154734.description:
Cha Youn-Aae works multiple jobs to care for her orphaned niece. Until one day when she got an opportunity: If she can clean up the mess that is the spoiled heir, she'll receive 300-million won!

Her hard work helps Kang Ju-Won, the chaebol heir with handsome looks and muscular physique but thuggish attitude, to finally clean up his act. But what will Youn-Aae do when Ju-Won says he's fallen in love with her? Cha Youn-Aae has been doing this for the sake of money, but now she finds it difficult to choose between 300-million won or love...

154758.description:
In the southwest area of the Zemulia Continent, one will find the tiny Liberl Kingdom. A small monarchy that has managed to defy all odds against attempts to overcome them during war. Liberl is split into five regions: Rolent, Bose, Ruan, Zeiss, and Grancel. In the city of Rolent, Cassius Bright has raised two children by himself, Estelle and Joshua.

He taught them everything they know himself, and encourages them to sign up to become apprentices in the Bracers Guild. Soon after, however, he receives a letter and has to leave on business, leaving Estelle and Joshua to fend for themselves. While working, they receive notice one day that their father's airship has gone missing. With this in mind, the two gear themselves up, and set off to find the ship and save their father.

Lisette is the daughter of a count who is destined to be devoured by monsters-and has experienced it four times already. Determined to avoid her fate, she moves out to what she calls the sanctuary—aka, the actual middle of nowhere. Monsters are rare here, so she should be able to live a peaceful life. But she's shocked when she's reunited with a handsome nobleman, Ralph, who rescued her way back when she was a poor orphan! Ralph surprises her with his pledge to live his life to serve and protect only her, and Lisette can't help but think: could she actually survive this lifetime?

154988.description:
From Hebi-Zou, the creator of Nihonjin no Shiranai Nihongo, comes a new seralization in the weekly magazine Morning: an educational manga that’s fun for adults! Set in a STEM university, this story brings you wonderfully brainy, and yet wonderfully dumb experiments. A few examples include testing why a stuntman can safely be on fire, turning on a fluorescent light that’s gone out, making a model skeleton out of fried chicken, and finding out why February only has 28 days.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

The topics included in each volume are:
  • Volume 1:
    • Why Is a Stuntman Safe Even when Engulfed in Flames? (スタントマンはなぜ炎にまかれても平気なのか？)
    • Why Does the Human Race Wash Their Hands Before Eating? (人類はなぜご飯を食べる前に手を洗うのか？)
    • How Did This Young Man Become a Famous Doctor Despite Not Being Able to Write? (字もかけない青年はどうやって名医になったのか？)
    • How to Light a Fluorescent Lamp That’s Gone Out? (切れた蛍光灯を灯すにはどうすればいいのか？)
    • What Do Scientists Dread Most? (科学者にとって最もホラーな出来事とは？)
    • Why Does February Only Have 28 Days? (なぜ２月は２８日しかないのか？)
    • Extras:
      • Bonus Manga (おまけマンガ)
      • Follow-Along Experiment Videos. So Easy!! (とても簡単!!「実験動画解説」)
      • Special Interview: “The History of Science is Not a Constant.” (Hideto Nakajima, professor at the Tokyo Institute of Technology) (特別インタビュー「科学の歴史は、不変ではない。」（東工大・中島秀人教授）)
      • Keshimane Tidbits (「決マネ」コボれ話)
      • Bonus 4-Panel Manga (おまけの四コマ)
  • Volume 2:
    • How to Completely Erase a Hard Drive? (ハーディスクのデータを完全に消去するには？)
    • Can Schrödinger’s Cat Leave the Box? (シュレディンガーのネコは箱から出られるのか？)
    • What Is December 25th for, Really? (１２月２５日はなんの日なのか？)
    • How to Quickly Find a Lost Child? (迷子を素早く探すには？)
    • How Was the Length of One Meter Decided? (「１メートルの長さ」はどう決まったのか？)
    • How to Make Cheap Ingredients into Classy Ones? (安い食料を高級にするには？)
    • How to Communicate your Feelings to Someone? (相手にちゃんと想いを伝えるには？)
    • Extras:
      • Bonus Manga (おまけマンガ)
      • Follow-Along Experiment Videos. So Easy!! (とても簡単!!「実験動画解説」)
      • Special Interview: “Designing Fun” (Motoki Shino, associate professor at Tokyo University) (特別インタビュー「『おもしろい』を設計する。」（東大・小竹元基准教授）)
      • Keshimane Tidbits (「決マネ」コボれ話)
      • Bonus 4-Panel Manga (おまけの四コマ)
      • Afterword Manga (あとがきマンガ)
  • Volume 3:
    • How to Take Fingerprints with Household Items? (身近なもので指紋を採取するには？)
    • How to Entertain a Group of People? (大勢の人を楽しませるには？)
    • How to Turn a Screw with Broken Threads? (ねじ山がつぶれたねじを回すには？)
    • What’s Needed for a Time Machine? (タイムマシンに乗るためには？)
    • How to Know that It’s Love? (それが恋だと気づくためには？)
    • How to Make Your Love Complete? (恋愛を成就させるためには？)
    • Extras:
      • An Explanation of Neutrinos (「ニュートリノ」解説ページ)
      • Retrospective: 10 Years Ago (前日譚「10 Years Ago」)
      • Bonus Manga (おまけマンガ)

154991.description:
The Way Of The Dragon Is The Way To Become Strong!

XXXX, a man used and abused for general tasks by his adventuring party, finds himself on the verge of death in dragon territory in the Kugus Mountains after a party member stabs him in the back. Literally. Next time he opens his eyes, he's in the nest of a red dragon named Kaphal whose egg was destroyed in a natural disaster. Having lost both his memories and his name, he turns instead into a young girl named Lushera. And apparently Kaphal plans to raise Lushera as her own daughter…? This is the story of the odd fate binding one dragon and one human, the story of an unconventional mother and daughter.

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

154992.description:
Here in this magic academy city of Ashram, where everyone is required to live in dormitories, a close-knit group of girls known as "Pentagrams" pursue their studies, including training in manners and magic, to become "true ladies." Arsnotoria, one of the students in Ashram, lives in Dorm 5 and is always with her dormmate friends: Mel, who's the life of the party, Petit Albert, who's quiet and does things at her own pace, Picatrix, who wants to be the class president, and Abramelin, who's always cool. They take classes and work on their school duties together, and they throw tea parties after school in "that room"... We'll share the girls' fun and lively days with you!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
